# eosllm

> llms.txt for the eosllm repository (embeddedos-org/eosllm).
> Status: on-device LLM inference engine in portable ISO C99 —
> version 0.1.0, ABI 1 (per `include/eosllm/eosllm.h`). The MCP
> server metadata is registered via the root `server.json`
> (io.github.embeddedos-org/eosllm, v0.1.0).

eosllm is the LLM inference runtime of the eAI product family —
the on-device AI layer of EmbeddedOS. It compiles to a single
static library (`libeosllm.a`) with a stable C ABI, plus
command-line and local HTTP/SSE server tools that run
Llama/Qwen2-class GGUF models (and the native `.eosm` format)
entirely locally: greedy text generation, quantization schemes,
and capability-scoped inference for agents.
